toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create the complete standalone HTML requested. All CSS and JS inline, no dependencies, Canvas 2D only. Attractive dark technical studio presentation, large central rotating colored cube, heading Gouraud / software light study, live FPS, compact accessible buttons and keyboard W wireframe and P pause with states. Responsive. Implement actual CPU triangle rasterizer into ImageData with barycentric color interpolation and z buffer (not gradients or flat triangles). 8 cube vertices at +-1; 6 outward consistently wound quad faces with separate face normals and tasteful saturated base colors. Explicit rotation matrices combined and applied to vertices and normals; camera at origin looking positive z, cube translated to z=5.5; perspective projection with inverted screen y. Backface cull by dot outward transformed face normal with vector toward camera >0. Split each visible quad into 2 triangles. Compute Lambert lighting at EACH of its four transformed vertices using normalized vector from vertex to a smoothly orbiting point light, ambient plus diffuse; interpolate resulting RGB across triangles preferably perspective correct via reciprocal z. Per-face normals are appropriate hard cube edges, but point light produces differing lighting at corners. Rasterizer bounding boxes clipped, accept either winding using signed area barycentrics, test depth, use pixel centers, write opaque RGBA. Clear image data background and depth every frame. Bound internal render resolution to roughly 600x450 or proportional max 700 pixels wide with adaptive viewport sizing to keep realtime CPU performant; display upscale with Canvas 2D drawImage from an offscreen canvas, no WebGL. Add subtle background grid and glow using Canvas2D separately before drawing transparent raster buffer or use backdrop CSS with transparent pixels; ensure clear alpha initialized to zero then triangles opaque. Draw moving point light marker at projected world position with soft 2D glow, optionally depth-test marker to avoid showing through cube. Wireframe toggle overlays visible triangle edges including diagonals on projected vertices using 2D strokes. Pause freezes rotation AND light elapsed animation time while render requestAnimationFrame and live FPS continue. Use performance timestamps, clamp dt, smoothed FPS updated every ~250ms, no frame-based motion. Resize reallocates buffers only when dimensions change, guard zero dimensions; handle DPR economically. Add concise comments explaining pipeline and controls and useful tiny footer '8 vertices · 12 triangles · Canvas 2D'. Ensure actual cube stays large and fits viewport with light near it. Fully implement all functionality with clean English code. Write the file now."}
